observations.behavior: Adds GitHub integration clearing to team deletion cleanup list.
observations.posthog_connection: This entry ensures that when a team is deleted, the cleanup routine calls the new signal handler to clear channel repositories associated with GitHub integrations before the team and its related data are removed. This prevents orphaned repository references in channels after team deletion.

observations.behavior: Adds database migration to clear repositories for channels with disconnected GitHub integrations.
observations.posthog_connection: This migration clears repository lists for channels that have no GitHub integration but still have repositories listed. This could occur if a GitHub integration was deleted while the channel still retained repository references, or if the channel was created with repositories before the GitHub integration was established.
